title: yummy solo dinner mix jamaican ground nut oil pastry
description: A citrusy, crumbly, solo-dinner Jamaican dish featuring ground nut oil, nimono-simmer, shojin-friendly, vessel=ramekin. Perfect for a weeknight dinner

ingredients.name: ground nut oil
ingredients.notes: use high-quality ground nut oil for best flavor

instructions: In a small mixing bowl, combine warm water and sugar. Let it sit for 5 minutes until sugar dissolves.
Mix in yeast and let it sit for another 5 minutes until yeast is activated.
Add all-purpose flour, salt, thyme, orange zest, lime zest, and nimono powder to the mixing bowl. Mix until a sticky dough forms.
Gradually add ground nut oil and mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes elastic.
Place the dough in a greased ramekin and let it rise in a warm place for 30 minutes.
Bake the pastry for 20-25 minutes until it is golden brown.
Let the pastry cool for 5 minutes before serving.
